practical_scenarios.title: Sponsor insists on a preselected solution
practical_scenarios.situation: A sponsor asks the team to implement a specific platform and refuses discovery because the budget is already approved.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Acknowledge the decision context, clarify which decisions remain open, restate the underlying outcomes and risks, propose a short evidence-based fit and gap assessment, document assumptions and escalate only material risk or governance concerns.
evaluation_criteria: Creates evidence and a recorded rationale

practical_scenarios.title: Conflicting executive requirements
practical_scenarios.situation: Sales wants flexible discounts while finance requires strict margin controls and both call their requirement mandatory.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Identify underlying objectives and authority, quantify business and control impacts, model rules and exceptions, agree decision criteria, present options with trade-offs and record the accountable decision.

source.title: Business Analysis for Practitioners: A Practice Guide - Second Edition

practical_scenarios.title: Frontline users were omitted
practical_scenarios.situation: A replacement workflow has been designed with managers, but frontline users reveal critical exceptions during UAT.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Pause affected acceptance decisions, assess exception frequency and impact, observe frontline work, update requirements and process models, evaluate schedule and control effects, and change the engagement plan so operational users participate earlier.

practical_scenarios.title: Requirements keep changing
practical_scenarios.situation: The delivery team complains that the analyst changes requirements every Sprint.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Separate genuine learning, clarification and scope change; improve backlog discovery and acceptance examples, define decision thresholds, maintain traceability, expose the cost of changes and preserve flexibility where uncertainty remains.

practical_scenarios.title: Vendor demo appears perfect
practical_scenarios.situation: A vendor demo matches every headline requirement, and leadership wants to sign immediately.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Validate critical workflows with client data and roles, test integrations, security, reporting, administration and failure handling, model total lifecycle cost, check references and roadmap, and negotiate exit and data-portability terms.

practical_scenarios.title: Process automation increases delays
practical_scenarios.situation: After workflow automation, approvals are faster inside each team but end-to-end completion time increases.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Measure queue and processing time across the whole flow, inspect routing and rework, identify the system bottleneck and control behavior, redesign the process and metrics rather than optimizing local activity alone.

practical_scenarios.title: Dashboard numbers do not match finance
practical_scenarios.situation: An executive dashboard reports revenue figures different from the finance system.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Stop using the disputed metric for decisions, compare definitions, filters, timing and transformations, identify the authoritative source and owner, reconcile historical results, document lineage and publish one governed definition with limitations.

practical_scenarios.title: Critical NFR discovered late
practical_scenarios.situation: Load testing shows the new portal cannot meet peak demand one week before launch.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Quantify user and business impact, verify the workload assumption and bottleneck, present options such as scaling, scope control or phased launch, update measurable NFRs, secure a risk decision and define retest and rollback criteria.

practical_scenarios.title: API integration silently loses records
practical_scenarios.situation: Two systems return successful responses, but some customer updates never reach the target.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Establish correlation and reconciliation evidence, inspect asynchronous and retry behavior, define ownership and source of truth, add idempotency and dead-letter handling as appropriate, recover missing records and update operational acceptance criteria.

practical_scenarios.title: Migration reconciliation fails
practical_scenarios.situation: The target system contains the expected record count but customer balances do not reconcile.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Stop business cutover where impact is material, compare transformation and aggregation rules, trace samples to source, isolate affected populations, correct mapping or data, rerun controlled migration and obtain business-owner reconciliation sign-off.
evaluation_criteria: Does not accept record count alone

practical_scenarios.title: Privacy concern raised before launch
practical_scenarios.situation: A reviewer finds that an analytics feature uses personal data beyond the purpose communicated to users.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Pause the affected processing, map purpose and data flows, involve privacy and legal owners, assess necessity and individual impact, minimize or redesign use, update transparency and controls, and document residual-risk approval before proceeding.

practical_scenarios.title: UAT sign-off is politically pressured
practical_scenarios.situation: The sponsor asks users to sign UAT despite unresolved high-impact defects to protect the launch date.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Present defect impact and affected requirements, distinguish acceptance from schedule preference, propose mitigation or phased options, record residual risk and accountable approval, and refuse to represent unverified acceptance as complete.

practical_scenarios.title: Adoption is low after a successful deployment
practical_scenarios.situation: The system is stable, but employees continue using spreadsheets and email.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Investigate workflow fit, incentives, confidence and support using usage data and interviews, address process and policy gaps, improve training and leadership reinforcement, remove unsafe workarounds deliberately and track behavior and outcome measures.
evaluation_criteria: Uses evidence from users and data

practical_scenarios.title: Client requests unpaid extra scope
practical_scenarios.situation: A client asks for several additional analyses and calls them minor clarifications.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Clarify the decision value and effort, compare the request to agreed scope and assumptions, propose trade-offs or a change request, document impact on deliverables and timing, and preserve the relationship without silently absorbing material work.

practical_scenarios.title: Executive rejects inconvenient findings
practical_scenarios.situation: The analysis shows a favored transformation has a weak business case, and the executive asks to remove the downside scenario.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Validate the analysis, distinguish fact and assumption, explain why the downside is decision-relevant, present sensitivity and options, document the request and use governance or ethics escalation if material information would otherwise be misleading.

practical_scenarios.title: Cloud migration has no business outcome
practical_scenarios.situation: A program measures success only by the number of applications moved to cloud.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Reconnect the roadmap to business drivers, define workload-specific outcomes for risk, cost, agility and performance, identify modernization and retirement opportunities, assign benefit owners and adjust sequencing based on value and readiness.

practical_scenarios.title: Biased AI pilot results
practical_scenarios.situation: An AI pilot performs well overall but poorly for a small high-impact customer group.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Do not hide the subgroup result in the aggregate, assess harm and data representation, investigate model and workflow causes, strengthen human review and appeal, define group-relevant thresholds and decide whether to redesign, restrict or stop the use case.

practical_scenarios.title: Failing consulting engagement
practical_scenarios.situation: A twelve-week engagement is halfway complete, stakeholders distrust the outputs and the team cannot agree on scope.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Stabilize work, interview sponsor and delivery stakeholders, establish facts about objectives, decisions, scope, evidence and quality, identify root causes, agree minimum recovery outcomes and governance, rebaseline transparently or recommend closure if future value is insufficient.

evaluation_rubric.evidence: Frames the real need, evaluates context and options, and connects recommendations to measurable business value.
Selects appropriate techniques, includes affected stakeholders, facilitates decisions and communicates for shared understanding.
Produces clear, testable and traceable requirements, rules, models and process improvements with exceptions and controls.
Understands architecture, quality attributes, APIs, integrations, data migration, analytics and operational implications without pretending to be every specialist.
Defines UAT and performance evidence, measures benefits, identifies limitations and plans organizational readiness and adoption.
Uses hypothesis-driven inquiry, presents options and trade-offs, manages scope and commercial boundaries, and influences credibly.
Integrates security, privacy, compliance and AI risk, reports evidence honestly and escalates material harm appropriately.
